concepts.name: Parts of a Whole
concepts.description: A fraction represents one or more equal parts of a whole object or collection. Students learn to identify fractions using familiar objects such as fruits, chocolates, and shapes.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to represent fractions as equal parts of a whole or a collection.

concepts.name: Numerator and Denominator
concepts.description: Every fraction consists of a numerator, which indicates the selected parts, and a denominator, which shows the total equal parts.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and explain the numerator and denominator of a fraction.

concepts.name: Representing Fractions
concepts.description: Fractions can be represented using diagrams, shaded regions, number lines, and everyday situations.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to represent fractions using visual models and number lines.

concepts.name: Equivalent Fractions
concepts.description: Equivalent fractions represent the same quantity even though they have different numerators and denominators. They are obtained by multiplying or dividing both numerator and denominator by the same non-zero number.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and generate equivalent fractions.

concepts.name: Visual Comparison of Fractions
concepts.description: Students compare fractions using diagrams to understand that differently written fractions can represent equal portions.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to verify equivalent fractions using visual representations.

concepts.name: Comparing Like Fractions
concepts.description: Fractions with the same denominator can be compared by examining their numerators. Larger numerators represent larger fractions.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to compare fractions having the same denominator.

concepts.name: Comparing Unlike Fractions
concepts.description: Unlike fractions can be compared by converting them into equivalent fractions with a common denominator or by using visual models.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to compare simple unlike fractions using appropriate strategies.

concepts.name: Ordering Fractions
concepts.description: Fractions can be arranged in ascending or descending order after comparing their values.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to arrange fractions in ascending and descending order.

concepts.name: Fractions in Measurement
concepts.description: Fractions are commonly used in measuring lengths, weights, capacities, cooking, and sharing objects equally.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify and use fractions in practical measurement situations.

concepts.name: Problem Solving with Fractions
concepts.description: Students apply fraction concepts to solve simple real-life problems involving sharing, grouping, and measurement.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to solve word problems involving fractions in everyday contexts.

concepts.name: Understanding Parts and Wholes
concepts.description: This chapter develops the concept of fractions as parts of wholes, equivalent fractions, comparison of fractions, and their practical applications.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to represent, compare, order, and apply fractions to solve real-life mathematical problems.
